name: Sayama Kazuto

Penis Length: 18 cm

Cute baby boy.
A type that stimulates the maternal instinct of women.

Likes to be led by older girls.・・・ But lately he seems to have become a little more masculine. While evading the pursuit of the student council so that it won't be found out that Shizune is a couple, he develops love for her. These days, he's addicted to cosplay.
In addition, Ruri persuades him to abolish the "dating ban" on himself and struggles with Shizune to convince him.
